data.name: Guddu
data.gender_notes: Guddu is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Guddu is a diminutive name for the Sanskrit word 'Gudh', meaning 'the little one'. This name is commonly used in the Hindi language for young boys and conveys feelings of warmth, love, and protection. The name Guddu carries the meaning “Little One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Guddu usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Guddu is a name that embodies the divine essence of the child, reminding parents and caregivers to nurture and protect the little one on their spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Guddu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guddu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
